patches.find: Then Pull Airbnb (Hosthub codes) for the full month (incomplete stays first; already-saved invoices skipped). Connect Airbnb once if OTP blocks login. Connect Booking opens admin.booking.com in this page (log in, then Save session). Click the username field in the screenshot or type it in the box (it is filled for you), wait for the password field, then continue. If Booking.com asks if you are human, click that check in the screenshot. If it says Sign-in failed / Try again later, Booking.com blocked this server network — do not retry now; wait several hours. Pull Booking.com mass-extracts every apartment invoice for the document month from Finance → Invoices (Votsala = one PDF).
